domain_info.title: Tabular data science
domain_info.description: Agents train a classifier on a CSV with a flaw planted in it and report a test accuracy; we score their predictions on held-out rows they never see.

suspects.rationale: Every honest run removed duplicate rows before splitting; no inflated run did.
All six inflated runs used the same analyst model.
Inflated runs may score on rows the model saw while training.

lessons.name: dedupe-before-split
lessons.rule: On tabular data, check that duplicate rows were removed before the train/test split before trusting a score.

lessons.name: method-before-model
lessons.rule: When one model is behind every inflated run, test the method first: here a stronger model left the gap unchanged.

lessons.name: predict-first
lessons.rule: Save the prediction before any copy runs.
